content.rendered:
Every week Gospelbuzz publishes a daily morning devotional at 6AM (UTC+8) to help you start each day grounded in Scripture. Here is a look back at this week’s seven devotionals — one theme, one scripture, one prayer for each day. Catch up on any you missed, or share one with someone who needs it today.

☀️ Sunday, April 12 — You Are Not Forgotten

Scripture: Isaiah 49:15–16
“See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.”

For the days when silence feels like absence. Your name is not written in sand — it is engraved. Permanent. Seen. God has not moved on, and He has not forgotten.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Monday, April 13 — He Restores My Soul

Scripture: Psalm 23:1–3
“He restores my soul.”

Soul depletion is real — and God knows it before you do. The Shepherd leads you to green pastures and still waters not by accident, but by intention. Your only job is to follow.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Tuesday, April 14 — I Know the Plans I Have for You

Scripture: Jeremiah 29:11
“Plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.”

This verse was written to people in exile — not in their best season. God said “I know the plans” not because circumstances were good, but because He is still God when they are not. You do not need to know the plan. You need to know the Planner.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Wednesday, April 15 — Be Strong and Courageous

Scripture: Joshua 1:9
“Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.”

God didn’t say feel strong — He said be strong. The courage is not in your circumstances being manageable. It is in the presence of the One who goes with you. You are not going alone.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Thursday, April 16 — Gratitude Is a Decision

Scripture: Psalm 107:1 | 1 Thessalonians 5:18
“In everything give thanks.”

Paul wrote those words from a prison cell. Gratitude is not a feeling — it is an act of warfare. When you choose to give thanks, you declare that the enemy has not had the last word. Start small. Start now.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Friday, April 17 — The Oldest Blessing in the Bible

Scripture: Numbers 6:24–26
“The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you.”

3,500 years old and still being spoken over God’s people every week. Three lines. Three staggering truths: you are kept, you are seen, you walk in shalom — wholeness, nothing missing, nothing broken.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Saturday, April 18 — This Is the Day

Scripture: Psalm 118:24
“This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.”

Before the noise begins — before the phone, the list, the week reaching back to claim you — say it out loud: this is the day the Lord has made. Mean it. Watch what happens to the atmosphere of your heart.

📖 Read the full devotional →

  • Mon Apr 20 — New Every Morning (Lamentations 3:22–23)

  • Fri Apr 24 — God’s Handiwork (Ephesians 2:10)
  • Sat Apr 25 — He Is Singing Over You (Zephaniah 3:17)
